description: Shell script for testing Git checkout and ambiguity handling scenarios, including setting up repositories, testing branch switching, disambiguation of checkout commands, and verifying error messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs provided commands expecting failure, used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks the output of previous commands for specific patterns.
